[h2][b]PolyZ Patch Notes (0.2.2.0.0)[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]We've just released a significant update for PolyZ, focusing on core gameplay refinements, performance boosts, and a smoother, more immersive experience across the board. Dive in and check out what's new!

[b][u]Dont Like reading? We got you covered![/u][/b] 
[/p][previewyoutube="6qZ_okygim8;full"][/previewyoutube][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]New Feature: Proximity Text Chat![/b][/h2][p][/p][p]We're excited to introduce [b]Proximity Text Chat[/b] to PolyZ! This new feature allows you to [b]engage directly with nearby players[/b], fostering more dynamic and emergent interactions in the world. Whether you're planning a coordinated attack, negotiating a truce, or just chatting with fellow survivors, this will bring a new layer of communication to your gameplay.[/p][list][*][p][b]Default Key: Enter[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44974470/61ac7d8187510df5e1bbfc354fb688da67f3010b.gif"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]
Gameplay & Immersion Improvements[/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44974470/cbdbc036b646a9de22dd460e2968dbcc0d9082c6.gif"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]Fluid Camera & Combat:[/b] We've [b]removed camera lag[/b] from the player camera, ensuring a more immediate and responsive feel. Aiming camera speed has also been [b]increased for all weapons[/b], making combat more fluid and precise.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Polished Character Movement:[/b] Say goodbye to sluggishness! [b]Character movement now feels much more responsive[/b], and we've [b]polished animations[/b] across the board for both melee and ranged weapons.[/p][h2][b]Enhanced Vehicle Interactions:
[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44974470/836eee6d825d9b6f5115f59e84eaf5f1da3213cb.gif"][/img][/h2][list][*][p][b]Full Vehicle Destruction:[/b] Vehicles can now be [b]fully destroyed and explode[/b] with various weapons, not just the RPG, adding more dynamic combat scenarios.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Robust Vehicle Health:[/b] We've [b]increased vehicle hit resistance[/b], meaning hits need to be harder to register (this doesn't apply to weapon hits).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Smarter Entry/Exit:[/b] You can now [b]only enter/exit vehicles when a driver is present[/b], preventing unwanted pushing or examining of occupied vehicles.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Seamless Driving:[/b] No more engine shutdowns if a passenger exits! Drivers can now [b]continue driving uninterrupted[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]No Entering Wrecks:[/b] You can no longer [b]enter vehicles that are fully destroyed[/b] (exploded).[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Ragdoll & Physics Refinements:
[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44974470/9396dd1e8ae4e5934dfc63d69cb0b308b7b0c1b3.gif"][/img][/h2][list][*][p][b]Cleaner AI Ragdolls:[/b] Multiplayer AI ragdoll physics have been [b]fixed and now look much cleaner[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Smoother Vehicle Physics:[/b] The vehicle physics additions from our last update have been further [b]tweaked to run even smoother in multiplayer[/b].[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Crucial Bug Fixes:
[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44974470/4393973778b1211ce95adaf62913b0f06f5448e0.gif"][/img][/h2][list][*][p][b]No More Fall Damage on Vaulting:[/b] You will no longer [b]die from fall damage when vaulting[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hotkeys Saved:[/b] The bug causing you to [b]lose all hotkeys when your vest is destroyed by enemies[/b] has been fixed.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Functional Furnaces:[/b] The issue with [b]furnaces not being able to turn on or off[/b] has been resolved.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Vehicle Occupancy Fix:[/b] The bug where a [b]vehicle seat would remain occupied if a player logged off inside a vehicle[/b] in multiplayer is now fixed.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Weapon Equip Glitch:[/b] The issue where equipping a weapon inside a vehicle would leave you unable to interact with anything has been [b]fixed[/b].[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]Performance & Stability[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]Server Stability:[/b] We've [b]fixed a critical issue where vehicles would run damage functionality multiple times too quickly[/b], which was causing server crashes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Optimized Particles:[/b] The [b]vehicle smoke particle has been changed and optimized[/b] for better performance.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved FPS:[/b] We've [b]added LODs (Level of Detail) to the ambulance model to help save FPS[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Reduced Server Lag:[/b] Problems with [b]items not despawning[/b], which led to server lag, have been [b]fixed[/b].[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]Quality of Life & User Interface[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]New: Proximity Text Chat![/b] Engage with nearby players using our new [b]Proximity Text Chat (Default Key: Enter)[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved Map Controls:[/b] Map controls now feel [b]more responsive[/b] and no longer move on their own notes.content:
[h1]PolyZ DevLog #1: Deep Dive into Version 0.2.1.0.0[/h1]

[p]Hello Survivors![/p]

[p]For those of you who have already experienced the recent Version 0.2.1.0.0 update, we're excited to bring you our very first official PolyZ DevLog! This video offers a comprehensive deep dive into all the significant enhancements that have already landed in the game. We've packed this update with improvements driven by your valuable feedback, designed to make your survival experience smoother, more dynamic, and more fun![/p]

[h2]Key Highlights of Version 0.2.1.0.0:[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Refined Combat & Healing:[/b]
    [*] Experience a more fluid melee combat system with brand new combo moves, allowing for more strategic encounters.
    [*] Speed up your recovery with a new, engaging mini-game for faster medical kit usage.
[*] [b]Creative Mode Building Overhaul:[/b]
    [*] Hammers are now your essential tool for upgrading build parts.
    [*] Enjoy free and unlimited upgrading in Creative Mode, giving you ultimate freedom to construct your dream bases without resource constraints.
[*] [b]Significant Performance Boosts:[/b]
    [*] Dive into smoother gameplay with noticeable FPS improvements across the board.
    [*] Creative Mode, in particular, has received a substantial FPS uplift, making large-scale building more enjoyable.
[*] [b]Vehicle & Physics Adjustments:[/b]
    [*] Get behind the wheel with improved vehicle handling for a more realistic driving experience.
    [*] We've squashed several physics-related bugs for a more fluid and predictable world.
[*] [b]Essential Bug Fixes:[/b]
    [*] Addressed frustrating server reconnection issues.
    [*] Fixed various FPS drops that could hinder your experience.
    [*] Corrected weapon clipping problems for a cleaner visual.
    [*] Resolved critical item loss bugs, ensuring your hard-earned gear stays safe.
[/list]

[p]This update truly incorporates community feedback and suggestions to enhance every aspect of your gameplay experience. We're listening, and we're committed to making PolyZ the best survival game it can be![/p]

[h2]Watch the Full DevLog Here![/h2]
[p]For a detailed walkthrough of all these changes, including in-game footage and explanations, check out the full video devlog on YouTube:[/p]
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VzPir6lKDFg]PolyZ Devlog #1 (0.2.1.0.0) – Melee Combos, Healing Minigame, FPS Boost & Creative Mode Updates![/url]
[p]

notes.title: 0.2.1.0.0: The Combat & Performance Unleashed Update
notes.content: [h1][b]PolyZ Patch Notes (0.2.1.0.0)[/b]ːsteamthumbsupː[/h1][p][/p][h1][b][u]New Features & Core Gameplay:[/u][/b][/h1][h3][b]Melee Combat Overhaul:[/b] [/h3][p]We've implemented a significant overhaul to melee weapon combat, [b]including new combos[/b] to master![/p][h3][b]Persistent Melee Attack:[/b] [/h3][p]Melee weapon attacks can now be performed by [b]holding down the mouse button[/b] instead of repeated clicking for continuous strikes.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44974470/a068eb4b8e66eed0e82327632a433d50db9a4729.gif"][/img][/p][h3][b]Build Tool Functionality:[/b][/h3][p]The Hammer and Improvised Hammer can now be used to [b]strike build parts to upgrade them[/b].[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44974470/1a30427b6376f977f4f9346900a737cba1d2a808.gif"][/img][/p][h3][b]New Medical Kit Mini-Game:[/b] [/h3][p]Introducing a new interactive mini-game when using medical kits! Successfully completing the mini-game will [b]increase the healing animation speed[/b], allowing you to recover health more quickly and efficiently. This adds an engaging element to health recovery.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44974470/f4eb4fd92f904c99ebc658dbc5401322416c297e.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1][b][u]Creative Mode Updates:[/u][/b][/h1][h3][b]New Teleport Portal:[/b][/h3][p]Added a new teleport portal in Creative Mode that takes you to the [b]shopping mall roof from the mall floor[/b].[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44974470/721480c197ad3fb95bb8e7d740aa50eabe604fe5.gif"][/img][/p][h3][b]Creative Mode Teleport Fix:[/b][/h3][p] Fixed an issue where players could become [b]stuck in the ground[/b] when teleporting back to the shopping mall from the airfield in Creative Mode.[/p][h3][b]Resource Cost Adjustment:[/b] [/h3][p]Upgrading Built Parts in Creative Mode is now cost free[/p][h1][/h1][h1][b]Performance Improvements:[/b][/h1][p][/p][h3][b]Rendering Performance Improvement:[/b] [/h3][p]Optimized the "Velocity Pass" by integrating it directly into the depth rendering pipeline. This change reduces redundant GPU work, resulting in improved frame rate consistency and overall performance, particularly in graphically dense areas. This also enhances the quality and efficiency of temporal effects such as motion blur and Temporal Anti-Aliasing (TAA).[/p][h3][b]Optimized Particle Effects:[/b] [/h3][p]We've fine-tuned the internal resolution used for GPU particle simulations (things like explosions, smoke, and environmental effects). By adjusting this, we've reduced the workload on your graphics card, which should result in smoother performance and improved frame rates, especially during scenes with many active particle effects.[/p][h3][b]Improved Server Performance & Stability:[/b] [/h3][p]We've made a key adjustment to how the game's servers manage memory cleanup. By reducing the interval for "garbage collection," the server now processes memory more frequently in smaller, less disruptive chunks. This should significantly reduce intermittent lag spikes and provide a much smoother, more consistent experience on dedicated servers.[/p][h3][b]Static Mesh LOD Improvements:[/b] [/h3][p]We've enabled a new system that intelligently manages the detail levels of static objects (like rocks, trees, or buildings) based on your graphics quality settings. This means smoother performance, especially in highly detailed or distant areas, by ensuring your GPU isn't rendering unnecessary polygon detail.[/p][h3][b]Skeletal Mesh LOD Improvements:[/b] [/h3][p]We've implemented a similar system for animated objects (like characters) that adjusts their detail levels according to your graphics quality. This optimization helps to reduce the workload on your CPU and GPU during busy scenes with many animated entities, contributing to more stable frame rates.[/p][h3][b]Grass & Foliage Performance Boost:[/b] [/h3][p]We've enabled a setting that allows grass and other foliage to automatically vary their density and detail based on your chosen graphics quality. This is a significant optimization for open-world areas, providing noticeable performance gains and smoother gameplay in heavily vegetated environments.[/p][h3][b]Refined Interactive Elements:[/b] [/h3][p]We've fine-tuned how certain interactive game systems operate, yielding substantially smoother framerates, with potential increases of up to 60+ FPS in various situations. This behind-the-scenes optimization helps PolyZ run more efficiently, especially when interacting with complex player information.[/p][h3][b]Optimized Distant Foliage:[/b] [/h3][p]We've implemented a new system for how distant grass renders. This involves smarter culling and a dithered fading effect which means grass will now fade out smoothly rather than abruptly disappearing. This change not only improves visual quality by eliminating pop-in but also boosts performance by reducing the rendering load for distant foliage.[/p][h3][b]Creative Mode FPS Boost:[/b] [/h3][p]Increased FPS in Creative Mode by optimizing scene capture components that were previously capturing every frame unnecessarily.[/p][p][/p][h1][b]Physics & Combat Enhancements:[/b][/h1][h3][b]Smoother Vehicle Movement:[/b] [/h3][p]We've fine-tuned how other players' vehicles appear on your screen, particularly during network corrections. This adjustment should result in less sudden "snapping" or jittery movement for remote vehicles, leading to a more consistent and smoother experience when driving or observing vehicles in PolyZ's multiplayer world.[/p][h3][b]Smoother Vehicle Rotations:[/b] [/h3][p]We've further refined how other players' vehicles handle rotational corrections over the network. This adjustment should contribute to more fluid and less "snappy" turning and rotational movements for remote vehicles, enhancing the overall visual consistency in multiplayer gameplay.[/p][h3][b]Improved Object Solidity:[/b] [/h3][p]We've adjusted how physics objects resolve minor overlaps. This change should make objects feel more "solid" and prevent them from getting "stuck" or jittering when they are in slight contact or resting on each other. This contributes to a more predictable and robust physical world in PolyZ.[/p][h3][b]More Distinct Surface Friction:[/b] [/h3][p]We've adjusted how the friction of colliding objects is calculated. This change should lead to more noticeable differences in how slippery or sticky various surfaces feel when objects interact, adding more character to the physical world of PolyZ.[/p][h3][b]More Dynamic Bouncing:[/b] [/h3][p]We've adjusted how the bounciness of colliding objects is calculated. This change should lead to more distinct and potentially exaggerated bouncing behaviors when objects interact, bringing a livelier feel to physical reactions in PolyZ's world.[/p][h3][b]Melee Range Consistency:[/b][/h3][p]Melee weapons now all use the same consistent melee range for more predictable combat results.[/p][p][/p][h1][b]Bug Fixes & Quality of Life:[/b][/h1][p]Fixed a crucial bug where server disconnections could prevent players from reconnecting.[/p][p][b]Fixed FPS Drop with Crafting Stations:[/b] Addressed an issue where opening and closing the Furnace and Crafting Table interfaces could cause a significant drop in frame rate.[/p][p]Reduced [b]weapon wall clipping distance[/b] for all weapons.[/p][p]Disabled [b]right-click drop for secure containers[/b] to prevent accidental item loss.[/p][p]Fixed an issue preventing players from [b]punching while placing build parts[/b].[/p][p]Implemented a [b]delay to quick bar item addition[/b] to prevent bugs caused by spamming.[/p]

By adjusting this, we've reduced the workload on your graphics card, which should result in smoother performance and improved frame rates, especially during scenes with many active particle effects.

We've made a key adjustment to how the game's servers manage memory cleanup. By reducing the interval for "garbage collection," the server now processes memory more frequently in smaller, less disruptive chunks. This should significantly reduce intermittent lag spikes and provide a much smoother, more consistent experience on dedicated servers.

We've enabled a new system that intelligently manages the detail levels of static objects (like rocks, trees, or buildings) based on your graphics quality settings. This means smoother performance, especially in highly detailed or distant areas, by ensuring your GPU isn't rendering unnecessary polygon detail.

We've implemented a similar system for animated objects (like characters) that adjusts their detail levels according to your graphics quality. This optimization helps to reduce the workload on your CPU and GPU during busy scenes with many animated entities, contributing to more stable frame rates.

We've enabled a setting that allows grass and other foliage to automatically vary their density and detail based on your chosen graphics quality. This is a significant optimization for open-world areas, providing noticeable performance gains and smoother gameplay in heavily vegetated environments.

We've fine-tuned how certain interactive game systems operate, yielding substantially smoother framerates, with potential increases of up to 60+ FPS in various situations. This behind-the-scenes optimization helps PolyZ run more efficiently, especially when interacting with complex player information.

We've implemented a new system for how distant grass renders. This involves smarter culling and a dithered fading effect which means grass will now fade out smoothly rather than abruptly disappearing. This change not only improves visual quality by eliminating pop-in but also boosts performance by reducing the rendering load for distant foliage.
Increased FPS in Creative Mode by optimizing scene capture components that were previously capturing every frame unnecessarily.

We've fine-tuned how other players' vehicles appear on your screen, particularly during network corrections. This adjustment should result in less sudden "snapping" or jittery movement for remote vehicles, leading to a more consistent and smoother experience when driving or observing vehicles in PolyZ's multiplayer world.

We've further refined how other players' vehicles handle rotational corrections over the network. This adjustment should contribute to more fluid and less "snappy" turning and rotational movements for remote vehicles, enhancing the overall visual consistency in multiplayer gameplay.

We've adjusted how physics objects resolve minor overlaps. This change should make objects feel more "solid" and prevent them from getting "stuck" or jittering when they are in slight contact or resting on each other. This contributes to a more predictable and robust physical world in PolyZ.

We've adjusted how the friction of colliding objects is calculated. This change should lead to more noticeable differences in how slippery or sticky various surfaces feel when objects interact, adding more character to the physical world of PolyZ.

We've adjusted how the bounciness of colliding objects is calculated. This change should lead to more distinct and potentially exaggerated bouncing behaviors when objects interact, bringing a livelier feel to physical reactions in PolyZ's world.

notes.title: PolyZ Development: What's in the Works?
notes.content:
[b]PolyZ Development: What's in the Works?[/b]

The last two patches were crucial to pave the way for some exciting new content, and I want to assure you all that I'm continuing to work hard to improve PolyZ as much as possible. So, here’s a sneak peek into what’s currently in development for the upcoming updates.

First off, I believe the city needs more variety, with bigger and taller buildings to explore and loot. To address this, I’ve begun designing a new apartment block for the city. This won't just add height and structure, it’ll be home to zombified residents who never managed to escape their apartments, offering both danger and opportunity. You’ll be able to loot new interior containers in these buildings, adding more to discover with each floor.

Here's a sneak peek of what it's looking like so far. Keep in mind, it’s a work in progress—the final version will be taller and fully textured. This is what we have so far:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44974470/ba29cf7948fc3591ec3f5837749fbd2699166d0f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44974470/f6bdb0414cd53f9c36010db42ae45ef98558cb35.png[/img]

These apartment blocks will be added across the main city, making the area feel more complete and diverse compared to the industrial and commercial zones. This will also help bring more life and balance to the residential area, giving the city a fuller, more immersive feel.

---

[b]Introducing a New Trader System[/b]

While PolyZ already offers a massive map with plenty of POIs to explore, I feel like there’s room for more depth in gameplay. That’s why I’m excited to announce the upcoming [b]Trader system[/b], which will be similar to Escape from Tarkov's. You’ll be able to maintain [b]reputation/karma[/b] with different traders and complete tasks for them to earn unique items and currency.

To start, there will be three traders:
[list]
[*][b]Medical Trader[/b]
[*][b]Combat Trader[/b]
[*][b]Structure Trader[/b]
[/list]

Each will have their own set of tasks for you to complete. With each major update (not minor ones), new tasks will be added to expand the system and offer more ways to interact with traders.

At the moment, I don't have anything to share visually for the trader system, but I encourage you to join our Discord or follow the Steam community for future updates and sneak peeks.

Thanks for your continued support!

- PolyZ Dev

notes.title: PolyZ Update 0.1.00.004 – New Features, Fixes, and Improvements
notes.content:
[b]Patch Notes – Update 0.1.00.004[/b]

---

[b]Fixes & Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Healing & Consuming Animations:[/b] Fixed a bug that caused healing and consuming animations to lock the player into a cycle.
[*][b]Cancel Animations:[/b] Players can now cancel healing or consuming animations by pressing LMB or RMB.
[*][b]Double-Click to Consume:[/b] Added the ability to double-click on items in your inventory to consume them (works for healing and consumables).
[*][b]Stun Animation Fix:[/b] Fixed the player stun animation so it no longer plays while healing or consuming items.
[*][b]Movement Overhaul:[/b] Removed the "icy" feel from character movement. Movement is now more responsive and precise.
[*][b]UI Camera Shake Fix:[/b] Resolved an issue in game settings where the Camera Shake toggle would re-enable itself after applying changes and navigating between UI and game.
[/list]

[b]Balance Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Zombie Damage:[/b] Reduced zombie hit damage by 30% for more balanced combat.
[*][b]Bear Spawns:[/b] Lowered bear spawn rates by 25% to make encounters less frequent.
[*][b]Bear Speed:[/b] Slowed bear movement speed by 20% for a better balance in hunting and escape scenarios.
[*][b]Zombie Loot:[/b] Increased the loot spawn rate in zombies for better rewards after combat.
[*][b]Faction Compound Harvesting:[/b] Reduced the harvest rate of plants inside faction compounds for better resource management.
[/list]

[b]New Features:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Wood Stick Weapon:[/b] Players can now equip wood sticks as melee weapons.
[*][b]Hand-to-Hand Combat:[/b] Introduced a hand melee system with blocking and punching mechanics.
[*][b]Melee Weapon Aiming:[/b] You no longer need to aim to use melee weapons. Free-hitting is now possible with or without aiming.
[*][b]Mushroom Interactions:[/b] Added mushroom foliage around the world, which players can now interact with.
[*][b]Rivers & Water Sources:[/b] Rivers have been added to the main map. Players can drink directly from them and fill containers.
[/list]

[b]Other Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Jumping Mechanics:[/b] Reworked the jump to feel less "floaty" and more grounded.
[*][b]World Interactables:[/b] Removed the beeping sound that would play when looking at interactable items in the world.
[*][b]Tactical Helmet Physics:[/b] Fixed the physics on the tactical helmet for smoother interactions.
[/list]
